Definition: to make an uproar, or agitate greatly
BiblicalUsage: hûwm turns up where the Bible says to make an uproar, to roar, to be in tumult. In Ruth 1:19, the text says "that all the city was moved about them." In 1 Samuel 4:5, the text says "all Israel shouted with a great shout."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hûwm is a reminder that the nations belong to God, and His gospel is for all of them. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
RelatedEvents: Ruth's Loyalty; The Ark Captured and Returned; Solomon's Succession and Adonijah
